concepts.name: 赤绳封门
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished production concept sheet for an enemy-trapping circular Lv4 magic skill in a 2D Japanese shrine / simplified ukiyo-e flat vector game. Reference image is COLOR, graphical richness, cloud/fire calligraphy and shrine motif reference ONLY, not a composition to duplicate. Very important: render a perfectly round circle viewed perpendicular to its plane, no ellipse, no oblique camera, no 3D perspective, no realistic textures. Dark ink background, limited cream / vermilion / warm gold palette, crisp filled vector silhouettes with tapered curved shapes. Central 40% must remain open and dark so three small dark monster silhouettes are visibly trapped inside; NO fox character, NO giant fox guardian, NO tails, no HUD, no scenery, no readable text. Ring design should have real graphic weight, strong light/dark contrast, ceremonial drama, clear layered silhouettes, not dozens of thin uninteresting circles. Main skill occupies upper 75% of sheet, bottom 25% contains 5 individual matching element silhouettes for later independent vector redraw. Direction A: FOUR GATES AND SACRED ROPE PRISON. Four ornate red torii sealing gates at cardinal positions, thick intertwined golden shimenawa rope closes the ring, diamond-shaped rope knots and flowing red binding sashes; cream zigzag shide paper garlands and large ofuda seals hang from the cord and ripple inward. Eight small ceremonial lanterns alternate between gates, ivory foxfire tongues sweep along the perimeter, loose vermilion maple leaves and wispy cream auspicious clouds bridge gaps. Large vermilion corner crest stamps imply four directional locks. Strong asymmetrical flowing ribbon accents against rigid ceremonial gate structure. Motif legend bottom: torii gate, braided rope knot with shide, lantern, flowing foxfire, ornate seal stamp. Make it much more rich and powerful than a plain outline magic circle.
